evidence.sentence: For instance, our renewal application for NABH reaccreditation of our Pune hospital is currently pending before the appropriate authority.

Each of our hospitals at Thane, Pune and Indore has been certified by the National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers (“NABH”) and has been accredited in the field of medical testing by the National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (“NABL”).
In the past, our Thane hospital has also received the NABH Safe-I certification and the NABH ‘Nursing Excellence’ accreditation.
